text:
devin: FYI StreamlineAI (prospect -> pilot) asked if we can pin Llama4o v1.2 and a 4-bit quantized variant in EU + APAC. They need region pin for data residency + a guaranteed model version for audits. Can product triage?
rachel: customer context — low-latency inference for real-time summarization, target p50 <250ms for 128 tokens, and SOC2-like audit needs pinned model hashes. They're ok paying for reserved capacity if needed.
marie: quick triage questions: 1) do they require hosted or dedicated? 2) do they need private VPC? 3) license OK for Llama4o? Also please paste the intake form link and artifacts.
devin: they prefer hosted but will move to dedicated once stable. No air-gapped reqs. License team cleared Llama4o as OK for enterprise use (per customer legal). Intake form: https://redwood.internal/intake (filled w/ basic contact + dataset examples).
santiago: noted. Technical: Llama4o v1.2 isn't in our catalog yet. A 4-bit quantized variant will need quantization recipe + perf benchmarks. Rough resource estimate: 24GB GPU memory with KV cache for 2x concurrency baseline. Expect ~10-20% quality drop vs fp16; need eval prompts to verify.
jo: catalog steps: 1) verify model weights & license, 2) run model ingestion pipeline, 3) generate bench profile in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1, 4) publish model entry with pinned version + migration notes. Need: model tarball URL, license text, sample prompts, preferred baseline perf numbers.
legal-bot: please attach license file and attribution metadata. If any restrictive clauses, escalate to legal@.
marie: acceptance criteria proposal: - model entry published in catalog with pinned version v1.2 (hash) - quantized 4-bit variant available in EU + APAC regions - smoke tests pass: p50 <250ms, p95 <700ms for 128 tokens in hosted mode under 1rps baseline - regression eval: failure rate <2% on customer prompt set - deployment runbook + rollback policy documented.
santiago: timeline estimate: 3 weeks to onboard + quantize + basic tuning for EU only. APAC parity + region validation = +1 week. If customer buys reserved capacity and provides model artifacts sooner we can parallelize.
devin: StreamlineAI can provide model tarball and prompt set by EOD Monday. They're willing to sign a month of reserved capacity to accelerate.
marie: next steps: @jo please open product intake ticket and attach artifacts; @santiago allocate initial bench run next Wed; i'll flag as P1 for product backlog. If legal raises nothing, target canary in eu-west-1 in 3 weeks.
jo: will open ticket now: https://redwood.internal/issue/PRD-4098 — attaching checklist. Assigning to @santiago and @marie. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CI check for ingestion pipeline: pipeline/ingest -> queued
marie: thanks everyone. tagging @rachel for customer comms: we'll confirm timeline after we validate artifacts. :eyes:
